business_summary: GuangYuYuan Chinese Herbal Medicine Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells Chinese medicinal products. The company offers traditional Chinese medicine, fine Chinese medicine, and health wine. It provides its products in the form of pills, powders, tablets, hard capsules, granules, compound preparations, and medicated eight dosage forms. The company was formerly known as Topsun Science And Technology Co Ltd. and changed its name to GuangYuYuan Chinese Herbal Medicine Co., Ltd. in July 2013. GuangYuYuan Chinese Herbal Medicine Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Taiyuan, China.
business_summary_ko: 광위원한약유한회사는 한약재를 제조, 판매하는 회사입니다. 한의학, 고급 한의학, 건강주 등을 판매하고 있는 회사입니다. 알약, 분말, 정제, 경질 캡슐, 과립, 복합 제제 및 약용 8가지 제형의 형태로 제품을 제공합니다. 회사는 이전에 Topsun Science And Technology Co Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2013년 7월에 GuangYuYuan Chinese Herbal Medicine Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. GuangYuYuYuan Chinese Herbal Medicine Co., Ltd.는 1996년에 설립되었으며 중국 타이위안에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
